about.title: AzCactusDoctor
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Ed, also known as @azcactusdoctor. I’m an oncologist by training, but I just love plants. I grew up in San Juan, Puerto Rico, where everything grows well and everything is green. I have always loved gardening, but then I moved to Texas for medical training, and it was always hot, humid, and full of mosquitoes.
In 2011 I moved to Arizona and fell in love with the Sonoran Desert. Growing cacti and succulents is my passion, and I only grow plants that do well in the amazing Sonoran Desert.

faq.a: Every plant has a two-part Latin name, like *Opuntia microdasys*. The first word is the **genus**: a group of closely related plants, like a family name. The second word is the **species**, the specific plant, like a first name. So *Opuntia* is the genus of all prickly pears, and *microdasys* is the bunny ears cactus.

Browse the shop and add what you want to your cart, then choose how you'd like to get it. **Pick up at an event**: you reserve online, we message you to confirm, and you pay in person. **Ship to me**: you pay online on Stripe's secure page. Plants are picked up at plant events, candles and books at spirit-side events, and an order with both at events both sides attend. We can't bring every plant to every event, so your reservation tells us what to pack.

Yes, anywhere in the US except California and Hawaii, when you choose **Ship to me** and pay online. **Plants** ship bare-root (no pot) for a flat fee by size: $10 small, $15 medium, $20 large, plus $5 for each extra plant in the same box. **Candles** ship free. **Books** can be picked up at an event, and shipping for books is coming soon. Pickup at an event is always free. See [Upcoming events](index.html#events) for where we'll be.

Every plant we ship is **bare-root: no pot**. Our photos show plants in pots, which is how they come when you pick them up at an event. For shipping we remove the pot. When your shipped plant arrives, pot it in dry, gritty cactus mix and wait about a week before the first watering so the roots can settle.

**Spina (plants):** every Saturday, 8am–12pm, at Roadrunner Park Farmers Market, [3502 E Cactus Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85032](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=3502+E+Cactus+Rd%2C+Phoenix%2C+AZ+85032) (opens a map). Some events are for both sides and are tagged **Spina + Spiritus** in [Upcoming events](index.html#events). For other locations we update the site and post on social media a couple of days before.

Two ways. **Pick up at an event** and pay in person with cash or card. Or choose **Ship to me** and pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay on Stripe's secure page. We never see your card details.

faq.q: How often should I water my cactus?
faq.a: Water deeply, then wait until the soil is completely dry before watering again. In the Arizona summer that is usually every week or two, and in winter much less, often once a month or less. Use a pot with a drainage hole and never leave it sitting in water. Too much water hurts a cactus faster than too little.

faq.q: What if a plant is sold out?
faq.a: Sold out plants are taken off the shop until we have more. Join the email list at the bottom of the page and we'll send you a weekly update with new plants, candles and events.

faq.q: Can I reserve more than one of a plant?
faq.a: Yes, up to the number we have in stock, which is shown on each plant's page.

faq.q: How do I handle a prickly pear safely?
faq.a: Carry it by the pot. Opuntia pads have spines and tiny hair-like barbs called glochids that irritate skin. Use tongs or thick gloves if you need to touch the plant.

faq.q: Who do I contact with questions?
faq.a: Email [spinanspiritus@gmail.com](mailto:spinanspiritus@gmail.com). For plants, message [@azcactusdoctor](https://instagram.com/azcactusdoctor). For readings, candles and books, message [@sonoranmystictarot](https://instagram.com/sonoranmystictarot). At events, just ask us.

**Spina & Spiritus** (also written Spina and Spiritus, spinaandspiritus or spinanspiritus) is one shop with two sides. **Spina** is the plant side, run by **AzCactusDoctor** (Ed, also known as AZ Cactus Doctor): rare cacti, succulents, euphorbia, agave and caudex plants grown in Arizona. **Spiritus** is the spirit side, **Sonoran Mystic Tarot** (Don): intention candles, books and tarot readings. One site, one cart, one checkout.

faq.q: How much are the candles, and do they ship?
faq.a: Our Sonoran Mystic Tarot intention candles are $20 each in six scents (Essence, Awakening, Abundance, Meditation, Frankincense and Passion). Candle shipping is free anywhere we ship, and you can also pick them up at an event.

Books by Don Rumer-Rivera on the Spiritus side: *The Mediums: A Guidebook* (English and Spanish editions), *The Ultimate Power Within*, *A Silence Too Loud* and *A Space Between Breaths*. You can see every title and price in the Books section. Pick them up at an event; shipping for books is coming soon.

faq.q: How do I book a tarot reading?
faq.a: Readings are with Don of Sonoran Mystic Tarot. [Book a reading](https://sonoranmystictarot.com/#book-personal-tarot-readings) online and pick a time that works for you.
